property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer either returns true (no revert) after successfully calling transferFrom on caddress for each _tos entry, or it reverts; if it returns true then it must have returned true (no false) — i.e., when not reverted the function returns true.
For any non-empty _tos array, calling C.transfer either reverts or returns true (i.e., if it doesn't revert the returned value is true).
For any non-empty _tos, C.transfer either reverts or returns true; if it returns true then every external call to caddress succeeded (i.e., transfer returned true).
